book.name: Juanchi Caque
book.title: San Juan caque chuteca jun pila

content: Jesuca Diosichi Nao joe tinunca
Jesuca Diosi ereca Cristo tinun joeque quereiminlari jeralela Diosichi nalala jolajochunae. Junni Apa Diosica laquiraminlari jerale Diosichi nalalacanan laquiralarachunae.
Diosica laquirato, yachi mantaca meráminlayoe. Junbenan miralarayoe Diosichi nalalaca tsarasica laquiralarayoeque.
Diosica laquiratori, yachi mantaca meracaichunae. Yachi mantate nenano tenfe itoe.

Junni Diosica tennatuminlari chiquilaca ya mantaca merátusa carichi timinla joe. Tsan josanan, jerale Diosichi nalalari ya seitonlaca merátuto, fe lono podeilaichunae. Fe lominlari Jesuca Diosichi Nao joeque quereiminla joe. Chiquilanan yaca quereito fe lominlayoe.
Diosichi Naoca paca sen fiqui
Jesucristo toca patato mumunhinue. Junsi puyanue. Mumunhibisiri patatunue. Mumunhitobi, asan larito puyanue. Diosichi Tenca junca chiquilaca micarimin joe. Yari tsarasica pamin testico joe.
Junni Diosichi tobi pemanca testicola jolajoe. Casale Apa Diosi joe; junsi yachi Nao, ya Fiqui tinun, yanan joe; junsi yachi Tenca joe. Yala pemancala jotonan, mancari jolajoe.

Junni in totenan tsanquenan peman neca Jesucrístoca miintsan joe: Casale Diosichi Tencabe miintsan joe. Junsi Jesucristo mumunhica joeque tenca cato miintsan joe. Junsi Jesucristo asan larica joeque tenca cato miintsan joe. Jun pemancale nechi man junni miintsan joe.
Junni aman jana tsachila paca fiquicanantiya tsarasica jonhoe timinlayoe. Junto Diosi paca fiquicari fécari tsarasica joe tintsan jochunae. Junni Diosi patsanan yachi Naoca paca joe.

Tsan josanan, weyan weyanlari Diosi yachi Naoca pacaca quereituminla joe. Yalari Diosica tsabi catuto, junto yacanan nene pun curaminla joe. Diosichi Naoca quereiminla mantimini Diosichi fiquica tencabi talarachunae.
Diosi yachi Naoca itsantinue: Yari yachi Naobe penenaminlaca numatotiya sonnato polesa carimin joyoe tinue.
Yachi Naobe cayaica junlari numatotiya yabe sonnato polelaichunae. Cayaituminlari yabe sonnatulajochunae.
Seque meránun fiqui
Aman nulari Diosichi Naobe cayaicala joto, numatotiya sonnato polelaichunae. Junni junca seque miilaisa, nulachica erechun in pila tsanque quinayoe.
Chiquilari Diosichi mantate yabe ticatiya rocainari, chiquilaca meráchunae. Junnan luratuto rocaino podeilaiyoe.
Junni chiquilaca meráno joeque miratori, chiquila rocainunca cuwano joequenan miracaichunae.

Jesucrístobe penenamin tsachi manca pansile jutsa quichunae. Puyatuntsancari jutsa quichunae. Junni weyanlari tsanquinaminca quirato, Diosibe rocaintsan jochunae yape yaca perdonaisa. Tsanque rocainari, Diosi ya jutsa quiminca perdonaito, ya tsachica puyasa carituchunae. Junni weyan jutsa mantimini puyantsancari jutsa joe. Tsan jutsacari perdonainiideque rocaisa titiyoe.
Ti seiton quinatiya jutsasiri joe. Aman weyan jutsa mantimini puyantsancari jutsa itoe.
Diosichi nalala jutsa quede nenaminla itochunae. Diosichi Nao yalaca cuidainachunae yape yucan yalaca yucapiyaritusa. Junca miralarayoe.
Junsi man fiquinan miralarayoe. Chiquilari Diosichi jolajoyoe. Jerale uyanlari yucanchi jolajoe.

Junsi man fiquicaman miralarayoe. Diosichi Nao patato, chiquilachi tenca cuwaca joe yape tsa Diosica mirano podeilaisa. Chiquilari tsa Diosibenan, yachi Naobenan, penenaminla joyoe. Yari tsa Diosi joto, yasiri numatotiya sonnato polesa carimin joe.
Junni nulaca lachi nalalaca cuwenta payinayoe. Tencabe nenalarana! epe diosi joe tinun moldebe penenatuchun. Tsanqueri joe.
